author: theboxplymouth
title: Artist Commission: Tides & Tales Project
content:
OPPORTUNITY CALLOUT: ARTIST COMMISSION 🌊🎙️📦

@take_a_part_uk are looking for an artist-producer (or collective) to lead 'Tides & Tales', a multidisciplinary arts and heritage project for the East End community of Plymouth, capturing the histories of the working class fishing and ocean working area through intergenerational practices. They are seeking support in co-creating a podcast series and a 'Living Museum' cabinet with the East End community of Plymouth.

Funded by @heritagefunduk with support from The Box, this project captures the maritime heritage, oral histories, and contemporary stories of Plymouth’s East End - working directly alongside local residents and young lead producers from the Ocean City Influencers.

Key Info:
💰 Total Commission: £16,000 (£12,000 artist fee @ £300/day for 40 days + £4,000 materials/production)
📍 Location: East End of Plymouth
📅 Delivery Window: November 2026 – March 2027
⏳ EOI Deadline: Friday 23 October 2026

Requirements:
5+ years of socially engaged, collaborative practice
High-quality audio/podcast production skills
Experience in 3D design, fabrication, or curation for the mobile exhibition cabinet

Applications from Black, Asian, and Ethnically Diverse artists are warmly welcomed and encouraged.

Looking for a collaborator? Enquiries from artists who excel in one area (audio vs. physical design) and would like help matching with a partner are also welcomed.

How to apply:
Send your CV, a 2-page outline proposal, and work samples to kim@takeapart.org.uk by 23 October.

Full details: Available from @take_a_part_uk.

author: imaginariumarts
title: Seeking Ongoing Artist for YouTube Channel Assets (Kirby Style)
content:
ARTISTS AND DESIGNERS LISTEN UP!!! A pal of mine recently started his YouTube channel journey, and is seeking an ongoing artist to commission for assets! This guy REALLY loves to support real life human artists, and invests in human made work consistently!! He is really good people and really knows his shit.

Detail update: seeking ongoing artist for main channel assets and “branded” designs, will rotate roster of thumbnail of various artists for features!! (See pinned comment for more!)

‼️ The bulk of the work would be for channel art with fast turnaround time for his video content, and wants HUMAN MADE not AI!
‼️ Some requests will be less complicated, like thumbnail artwork, but other requests may be more detailed or specific, so flexibility is KEY!
‼️ Preference given to those who can replicate Kirby style content and character drawing, but send your portfolios of comics art so he can see who’s out here!
‼️ You will be paid fair compensation, so be ready to send your rates for consideration along with your samples if requested!
‼️ Potential for additional work as needed down the line if it goes well!
‼️I promise he is legitimate and real and worthy of your time and effort, and is worth submitting your work to as he will be respectful and professional!
‼️Plus he’s got a wicked sense of humor and is very chill and good people, so you will have A REALLY GOOD TIME working with him I do declare.

He’s added as contributor to this post, so he can go through the comments as you drop your info, so don’t be shy and introduce yourselves! Everyone is welcome to throw their hat into the ring if you wanna be considered for this very special YouTube channel!

COMMENT BELOW AND LET’S SEE WHERE IT LEADS YALL!
